quests.instruction: Touch the body part that includes your chest, tummy, and back all together -- but it is not your back!
quests.question: Torso
quests.hint: Your chest, tummy, and back are all part of it.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Torso is the name for the middle of your body, made up of your chest, back, and tummy!
quests.funFact: It houses almost all of your vital organs.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that you stretch out wide when you do a jumping jack -- but it is not your lungs!
quests.question: Limbs
quests.hint: You have four of these in total.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Limbs are your arms and legs, working together as a team!
quests.funFact: Limbs give humans the ability to manipulate tools and travel long distances.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found halfway between your shoulder and your wrist -- but it is not your thumbs!
quests.question: Elbows
quests.hint: You bend these to bring food to your mouth.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Elbows are the bendy joints in the middle of your arms!
quests.funFact: It has a 'funny bone' which is actually just a sensitive nerve.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to listen to happy music. It is NOT your nostrils!
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, one on each side of your head!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: Your ears continue to grow slowly your entire life.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you smack together after a tasty, sweet treat -- but it is not your hair!
quests.question: Lips
quests.hint: They are the soft edges around your mouth.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Lips are the soft edges around your mouth that help you smile and talk!
quests.funFact: They do not have sweat glands, which is why they get dry easily.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that touches the ground first when you walk, not your toes!
quests.question: Heels
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They touch the ground first when you take a step.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Heels are the round back part of your feet that touch the ground first!
quests.funFact: It strikes the ground first when you are walking normally.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you taste if food is sweet or sour. It is NOT your face!
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It helps you taste sweet, sour, and salty foods!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Your tongue helps you chew your food and speak clearly.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found underneath your muscles and skin, like a strong frame. It is also the one that a doctor studies to make sure all your bones are healthy, but it is NOT your knees!
quests.question: Skeleton
quests.hint: Hint: It is underneath your muscles and skin.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Skeleton is the name for all the bones in your body working together!
quests.funFact: Without a skeleton, you would be a puddle of soft tissue.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that you can gently feel right beneath your skin near your neck. It is also the one that helps hold your shoulder steady and in place, but it is NOT your waist!
quests.question: Collarbone
quests.hint: Hint: It connects your shoulder to your chest.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Collarbone is the thin bone below your neck that connects your shoulder to your chest!
quests.funFact: Your collarbone connects your arm to the rest of your skeleton.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part you protect from sunburn with sunscreen, not your skull!
quests.question: Skin
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Skin covers your whole body and helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough!
quests.funFact: It constantly renews itself, shedding dead cells and growing new ones.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that lets you fold your arms or bend down to sit. It is also the one that acts as bendy spots, helping your whole body move smoothly, but it is NOT your skeleton!
quests.question: Joints
quests.hint: Hint: They are found wherever two bones meet.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Joints are the bendy parts, like elbows and knees, where two bones meet!
quests.funFact: Some joints, like those in your skull, don't move at all.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that feels flat and soft, right in the middle of your hand, not your wrists!
quests.question: Palms
quests.hint: Here's a tip: A high five lands right on these.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Palms are the flat, soft inside part of your hands!
quests.funFact: They have complex creases that develop before you are even born.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found on the front of your knee, just under your skin. It is also the one that moves up and down when you bend your leg, but it is NOT your soles!
quests.question: Kneecap
quests.hint: Hint: You can feel it move when you bend your leg.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Kneecap is the small round bone at the front of your knee that protects it!
quests.funFact: The kneecap glides up and down when you bend your leg.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found around the base of every tooth in your mouth. It is also the one that you keep healthy by brushing gently every day, but it is NOT your nose!
quests.question: Gums
quests.hint: Hint: A dentist checks these along with your teeth.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Gums are the soft pink part in your mouth that holds your teeth in place!
quests.funFact: Brushing and flossing keeps your gums strong and pink.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to catch a big bouncy ball. It is NOT your fingernails!
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You clap these together to cheer!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: Sweat glands on your hands help you grip objects better.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you use to solve a tricky puzzle or remember a friend's name. It is NOT your backbone!
quests.question: Brain
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It helps you think and remember!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Brain helps you think, learn, and remember new things!
quests.funFact: The brain never stops working, even while you are dreaming.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that beats faster when you run, jump, or feel excited. It is NOT your limbs!
quests.question: Heart
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You can feel it beating in your chest!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Heart beats inside your chest and pumps blood all around your body!
quests.funFact: The heart is actually a specialized, incredibly strong muscle.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found on your back, just below each shoulder. It is also the one that helps your arm swing and lift with ease, but it is NOT your teeth!
quests.question: Shoulder Blade
quests.hint: Hint: You can feel it move when you shrug.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Shoulder Blade is the flat bone on your upper back that helps your arm swing!
quests.funFact: The shoulder blade allows your arm to move in many directions.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that lets your food travel down to your tummy when you swallow. It is also the one found inside your neck, where your voice comes from, but it is NOT your hips!
quests.question: Throat
quests.hint: Think about this: Your voice comes from here.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Throat helps you swallow food and lets your voice come out!
quests.funFact: A flap in your throat closes when you swallow so you don't choke.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you stand up straight and tall. It is NOT your brain!
quests.question: Backbone
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It runs down the middle of your back!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Backbone is the row of bones down your back that helps you stand tall and bend!
quests.funFact: The backbone protects the delicate spinal cord inside it.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part we pat gently after a big, yummy dinner, not your face!
quests.question: Tummy
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You pat this after a big meal.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Tummy is the middle of your body that helps digest the food you eat!
quests.funFact: Your tummy muscles help you bend over and sit up straight.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms small bumps you can see when you make a tight fist. It is also the one that lets your fingers bend and curl, but it is NOT your arms!
quests.question: Knuckles
quests.hint: Think about this: They let your fingers bend and curl.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Knuckles are the small joints that let your fingers bend and curl!
quests.funFact: They act as a hinge to let you close your hand into a fist.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found right under your shoulder, where your arm meets your body. It is also the one that gets gently squeezed when you hug someone tight, but it is NOT your elbows!
quests.question: Armpits
quests.hint: Think about this: They can feel very ticklish.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Armpits are the spot right under your arms, where your arms meet your body!
quests.funFact: Lymph nodes in your armpits help fight off infections.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that grows bigger and stronger while you are still a child. It is NOT your limbs!
quests.question: Bones
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are hard and hold your whole body up!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Bones are the hard parts inside your body that hold you up and give you shape!
quests.funFact: Bones are living tissue that constantly rebuild themselves.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found between your foot and your leg -- but it is not your soles!
quests.question: Ankles
quests.hint: Your socks cover these.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Ankles connect your feet to your legs and help you balance!
quests.funFact: The ankle allows your foot to move up, down, and side to side.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you lie down on to look up at the clouds -- but it is not your throat!
quests.question: Back
quests.hint: Your backpack rests against this part.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Back is the part behind you that helps you stand up straight!
quests.funFact: Good posture helps keep your back healthy and strong.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we brush every morning and every night. It is NOT your lips!
quests.question: Teeth
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You brush these with a toothbrush!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Did you know? enamel on your teeth is the hardest substance in your body.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that gets covered by a warm winter hat -- but it is not your eyelashes!
quests.question: Forehead
quests.hint: Your hair grows just above it.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Forehead is the flat part of your face above your eyebrows!
quests.funFact: It is often the first place to sweat when you get very hot.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to breathe in fresh air. It is NOT your tongue!
quests.question: Nose
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It sits right in the middle of your face!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your nose can remember over 50,000 different scents.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we open wide to sing a happy song. It is NOT your face!
quests.question: Mouth
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You open and close this to talk and eat!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your mouth produces saliva which starts digesting food right away.
